must: Use shared semantic slate, teal and amber tokens in both themes

React component shell and panels, React Icons navigation, plain task headings and compact surfaces.
Dark mode is the default regardless of OS preference; the optional light-mode choice persists locally.
Preserve existing automation controller and local Node API during frontend migration.
Your team uses a compact active-team header with immediate-save auto level-up, per-copy platinum bonus switches, distinct green HP/blue XP bars and a paginated owned inventory.
Inventory supports native drag/drop and keyboard/tap slot selection. No automatic selection, tier-training or replacement controls are shown.
